statement: Public 1302 compatibility implementations supply GET_ATTRIBUTES_VALUES (feature1 opcode 0x83) as a nonempty sequence of five tag/u32LE records: 1 product=0x1302, 2 capabilities=0, 10 bootloader build, 4 firmware build and 9 hardware revision. Linux v7.3 recognizes the 5-byte numeric record format but only consumes tag11 as an optional sensor interval; SDL Triton wired InitDevice does not query attributes. Claimed Steam-side attribute gate is source-author testimony, not public Valve client validation. C6 returns zero entries.

applicability.revision: Source pins enumerated in corresponding source records; actual retail version not identified
applicability.firmware: not measured for D9; published firmware tuples not adopted
applicability.scope: A: 1302 public implementations, not verified private Steam gate
